integrity: Exact symbolic polynomial identities and finite-field enumeration checked; proof of finite flatness and characteristic exclusion is mathematical, not inferred from finite tests. The first source is prior work on the characteristic-zero ideal. No independent external audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the specified integral complete intersection, obtained from the published complex 48-point scheme; no assertion is made about intrinsic osculation or sextactic schemes in characteristics 2 and 3, nor about unrelated integral models.
title: Arithmetic specialization of the 48 Fermat-quartic sextactic points
